hero.title: BALLOONS
hero.sub: A rookie FIRST Robotics Competition team that punches above its weight. Small by design — built to expand.

about.label: About
about.headingRest: learning to build a competition robot from nothing.
about.body: BALLOONS is the rookie FRC team at TED Antalya Koleji. Every season we design, machine, wire, and code a robot from a blank sheet — and we're looking for partners to help us build the very first one. Like our namesake, we're small for now, and built to expand far beyond our size.

support.label: Support
support.body: Backing a rookie team is the highest-visibility, lowest-cost partnership in our season. Your support buys parts, tools, and travel — and in return your name travels with us everywhere we go.

cells.title: On the robot
cells.body: Your logo rides on the robot, the pit, and the team's apparel — seen by every team, judge, and spectator at competition.

cells.title: Named partner
cells.body: A credited partnership across our website and social channels, with the recognition that comes from believing in a team first.

cells.title: Workshop visit
cells.body: A live demo and behind-the-scenes look for your organization — a real STEM story you can share with your own people.

cells.title: A front-row seat
cells.body: You watch a rookie team's entire first season unfold, from empty workshop to the moment the robot drives.

sponsors.label: Sponsors
sponsors.body: We haven't signed a sponsor yet. That means the first names on board don't just join the season — they define it. Claim a space before anyone else does.

members.name: Can
members.body: Leads the team and its most technical work — from mechanism design to drive code.

members.name: Open seat
members.body: Owns the chassis, mechanisms, and everything that physically moves on the robot.

members.name: Open seat
members.body: Writes the code that turns a static design into a robot that thinks and responds.

rows.title: STEM workshops
rows.body: Hands-on sessions that introduce younger students to engineering before they think it's not for them.

rows.title: Open build days
rows.body: We open the workshop so anyone can watch a competition robot actually come together.

rows.title: Rookie mentorship
rows.body: Sharing everything we learn the hard way with the next teams starting from zero.

footer.blurb: Rookie FRC team at TED Antalya Koleji — building our future one mechanism, one idea, and one bold dream at a time.
